operational_nodes.name: RangeSliceAstDetector
operational_nodes.doc: Zero-regex token-stream analyzer that detects panicking Rust bracket range indexing (`expr[a..b]`, `expr[..b]`, `expr[a..]`) outside string literals, comments, and `.get(..)` calls

operational_nodes.name: FailClosedIoAstVerifier
operational_nodes.doc: AST pattern verifier that rejects fail-open iterator flattening, `.filter_map(Result::ok)`, `.unwrap_or_default()` on filesystem reads, and `let _ = fs::` error discarding

operational_nodes.name: AntiGamingTestBodyAuditor
operational_nodes.doc: Test AST auditor that parses `#[test]` functions and rejects zero-assertion bodies, `mem::size_of` tautologies, unguarded `.exists()` skips, and non-RAII temp paths

operational_nodes.name: SsotSymbolDeduplicationGate
operational_nodes.doc: Workspace-wide AST symbol scanner enforcing single-module residency for SHA-256 constants (`0x428a2f98`) and Rust lexical state machines

operational_nodes.name: Check34AstPurityAndAntiGamingGate
operational_nodes.doc: Total detected panicking direct range-slice indexing expressions (`expr[a..b]`) across audited workspace modules [unit: count]
